# Archana Travels

> Archana Travels is a trusted car travel service founded in 1975, based in Sholinghur, Ranipet, Tamil Nadu, India. Owned by K. Keerthiraj, the company provides outstation trips, airport transfers, pilgrimage tours, wedding vehicles, and corporate travel across South India.

## Services

- Outstation Trips: Long-distance travel to any destination across South India
- Airport Transfers: Reliable pick-up and drop to Chennai, Bengaluru and nearby airports
- Pilgrimage Tours: Dedicated vehicles for Tirupati, Rameswaram, Shirdi, Vaishno Devi, Kanchipuram and more
- Wedding Vehicles: Premium cars and vans for weddings, receptions and related events
- Corporate Travel: Office commute, employee transport, business trips and conferences
- Local City Rentals: Hourly and daily rentals within Sholinghur, Ranipet and surrounding areas

## About the Owner

K. Keerthiraj founded Archana Travels in 1975 with a vision to provide safe, comfortable and reliable travel. With over 51 years of experience in passenger transport, Archana Travels has served thousands of families, pilgrims, corporate clients and wedding parties across South India. All vehicles are personally inspected; all drivers are trained, licensed and professional.
